snippet.title: CarX Street - Official Console Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
CarX Street - Official Console Gameplay Trailer.
#carxstreet #carxtechnologies 

What's up, drivers!
CarX Street is coming to consoles! 

Pre-Order for Xbox is now open and will be released on June 18, 2025. 
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/carx-street/9nn082lmvv2c

Sony PlayStation will be released summer, 2025. 

Conquer mountain roads, highways, and city streets. Build your dream car with detailed tuning that unleashes the potential of “CarX Technology”© physics. Take part in thrilling races, enjoying realistic gameplay and dynamic driving.

Stay tuned for the news!
